# Tender Response — RTL-2026-07
**Visakoivu Oy** to Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds public liability insurance of EUR 2,000,000, exceeding the required EUR 1,000,000 minimum. Our equity ratio for FY2025 was 35.2%, above the required 20%.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.2 Personnel qualifications.** Personnel working on site hold the relevant trade qualifications for LVI, sähkö and rakennusautomaatio disciplines, supported by our NMSB 75310:2018 occupational health and safety system.

**4.3 Environmental management.** Works are carried out under our NMSB 74210:2015 certified environmental management system.

**4.4 Building automation.** Our rakennusautomaatio team supports both BACnet and Modbus protocols, drawing on experience including a building automation renewal for Petäjälahti Oy at a logistics centre.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Pricing structure.** Fixed price for scheduled maintenance, with corrective work priced separately on a time and materials basis. Pricing is structured to reflect the extended-hours operating pattern described in the tender.

## 6. Submission requirements

Visakoivu Oy is certified to NMSB 7310:2015.

## Annex A

**A.1** Lift maintenance is carried out in compliance with applicable statutory requirements.

**A.2** Periodic electrical inspections are scheduled and documented in line with statutory intervals, drawing on our LUSA-qualified sähkö team.

Visakoivu Oy has delivered comparable framework agreements including a EUR 1,650,000 property and LVI maintenance framework for Järviseudun hyvinvointialue across five health stations, and a EUR 1,120,000 school-properties framework for Keski-Vaaran kaupunki.

These two contracts, together with our LVI and electrical outsourcing work for Haavikkoranta Oy, reflect the scale and mix of work relevant to this contract.

We would welcome the opportunity to discuss this proposal further.
